group_note: close-cousin sibling, own content (炎黄英雄史). Status corrected from a stale 'limited' -- shares the exact same real bug as sibling yanhuangwuhun (045), now fixed in both: adm/daemons/logind.lpc's check_ok() called MESSAGE_D->find_chatter() completely unguarded on every successful login, and MESSAGE_D fails to compile under WASM (raw socket calls) -- the uncaught 'No program in object' error aborted check_ok() mid-execution, leaving every subsequent command including quit printing '什么？' with no room ever entered. Fixed by guarding the call with find_object(MESSAGE_D). Re-verified clean after the fix: admin login (fluffos/Mud@2026) enters the world normally, '目前权限：(admin)', quit clean ('欢迎下次再来！'). This lib's prompt shows a live clock -- used --idle 0.3 for testing.
